answer: A falcon-patrol velvet courier relay stops clones. First, each newcomer locks 400 POA and gets a sealed velvet pouch with an umber stamp. Second, it must finish 12 real deliveries in 12 districts in 72 hours, stamped on receipt. Third, three falcon auditors re-run two deliveries at random; any mismatch burns the bond and bans the pouch. Fourth, after 30 clean days the bond unlocks. Forging 1,000 clones costs 400,000 POA plus 12,000 deliveries, about 3,000 hours of work. Like a falconry guild where every bird must fly true hunts before it earns its jesses.
